description: The University of Stavanger publishes one year of solar-radiation and electricity-output observations from two back-to-back photovoltaic panels facing north and south in a dense urban setting. The polycrystalline panels are separated by ten centimetres, allowing comparison of orientation effects under the same local conditions. Zenodo version 2 provides data and supplementary RAR archives, with Excel-derived efficiency information, freely under CC BY 4.0. The time series can help calibrate simulations of facade-PV output and building energy-supply models. The study concentrates on sunny days even though the archive covers other weather, so conclusions about cloudy conditions remain limited. Site shading and the specific module technology constrain transfer. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Dataset for the Solar Incident Radiation and Electricity Production BIPV/BAPV System on the Northern/Southern Façade in Dense Urban Areas
